notes: Reference decomposition for the FairLend choose-your-route section. Crops are references only and must not be shipped as final assets.

assets.label: FairLend route selector section
assets.role: Full responsive route-choice section with intro, route cards, and helper CTA
assets.rationale: The section is composed of editable typography, reusable cards, buttons, badges, and generated image assets.

implementation.acceptance: Responsive section preserves the centered editorial heading, four-card desktop grid, selected-card state, route progress rows, lower helper banner, and subtle topo-paper background.

assets.label: Route choice card
assets.role: Reusable card for one route option
assets.rationale: Mostly live text, badge state, icon, list, CTA, and progress UI with one raster illustration slot.

implementation.acceptance: Card supports selected/default variants, optional status badge, icon slot, bullet list, four progress steps, illustration asset, and CTA.

assets.label: Route step progress track
assets.rationale: Simple dots, rules, arrows, and editable labels are better as React than raster.

implementation.acceptance: Track keeps fixed dot spacing, active lime first step, dark inactive steps, arrows between labels, and no layout shift.

assets.label: Route icon badge
assets.role: Reusable lime-highlight icon badge used at the top of each route card
assets.rationale: The badge glow and black line icon are simple vector/CSS elements and should remain themeable.

implementation.acceptance: Badge renders a soft lime circular wash with a black lucide icon and consistent sizing.

assets.label: Route helper CTA banner
assets.role: Lower recommendation prompt with compass asset and CTA
assets.rationale: Editable heading, body copy, divider, and CTA should be React, while the compass is a generated raster asset.

implementation.acceptance: Banner supports image slot, live text, vertical divider, and compact lime CTA button with black arrow box.

assets.label: Topographic paper background
assets.rationale: Faint contour-line paper texture is a raster-heavy background treatment.

generation.prompt: Generate a new standalone off-white topographic paper texture for a premium finance website background. Very subtle gray contour lines, tiny elevation numerals, soft paper grain, clean rounded-corner page feel, sparse edges, no UI cards, no headline text, no buttons, no logos, no people. Aspect ratio 4:3.
generation.negative_prompt: interface, cards, readable headline, logo, dark colors, high contrast, map labels, stains, folds

assets.label: Investor skyline engraving
assets.rationale: Dense pen-and-ink city skyline with bridge detail is a complex illustration asset.

generation.prompt: Generate a new standalone transparent PNG-style black graphite pen-and-ink engraving of a modern Canadian city skyline with a bridge in front, centered, low horizontal composition, light stipple shading, premium mortgage/investment editorial style, no text, no UI, no border. Match the reference crop's monochrome etched line quality.
generation.negative_prompt: color fill, photorealism, watercolor, thick cartoon outlines, readable text, logo, people, rectangular background

assets.label: Private mortgage house engraving
assets.role: Card illustration for private mortgage route
assets.rationale: Detailed residential house drawing is best as a generated image asset.

generation.prompt: Generate a new standalone transparent PNG-style black graphite pen-and-ink engraving of an elegant two-story suburban house with garage, pitched roof, shrubs, and light trees, front three-quarter view, centered low horizontal composition, fine etched shading, no text, no UI, no border.
generation.negative_prompt: color fill, photorealism, cartoon, heavy background, readable text, logo, rectangular canvas

assets.label: Construction building engraving
assets.role: Card illustration for construction financing route
assets.rationale: Detailed building frame and crane engraving is a complex raster illustration.

generation.prompt: Generate a new standalone transparent PNG-style black graphite pen-and-ink engraving of a mid-rise construction site: concrete building frame, tower crane, small ground details, centered low horizontal composition, fine architectural sketch lines and stipple shading, no text, no UI, no border.
generation.negative_prompt: color fill, photorealism, cartoon, workers closeup, readable text, logo, rectangular background

assets.label: Partner handshake engraving
assets.role: Card illustration for partner program route
assets.rationale: The handshake uses dense engraved cloth, hands, and stipple texture better handled as image generation.

generation.prompt: Generate a new standalone transparent PNG-style black graphite pen-and-ink engraving of two business people shaking hands, cropped at the wrists with suit sleeves, centered horizontal composition, detailed stipple and crosshatch shading, no text, no UI, no border.
generation.negative_prompt: color fill, photorealism, cartoon, extra hands, readable text, logo, rectangular background

assets.label: Route compass engraving
assets.role: Compass illustration in lower helper CTA
assets.rationale: The angled compass includes dense sketch shading and transparency/shadow requirements.

generation.prompt: Generate a new standalone transparent PNG-style black graphite pen-and-ink engraving of an antique compass angled slightly clockwise, circular metal case, visible needle and dial markings, light drop shadow, fine stippled shading, no text labels, no UI, no border.
generation.negative_prompt: color fill, photorealism, cartoon, readable brand text, logo, rectangular background
